brief.inspiration: generic 2010s NATO MBT with a slab-sided turret and a long 120 mm gun
brief.size: 9.5 m long incl. gun, like the model it replaces
movingParts: P_turret (yaw, pivot on the turret ring)
brief.teamPaint: hull and turret paint (material Paint); running gear below 0.95 m stays textured

reference.prompt: <vehicle prefix> Main battle tank: low wide hull, seven road wheels per side with rubber tracks and side skirts, wedge-shaped composite armor turret front with a large rear bustle, very long 120 mm smoothbore gun, commander sight and roof machine gun.

<vehicle prefix> Main battle tank: long flat hull with sloped glacis, six large road wheels per side with rubber tracks, flat angular slab-sided turret, very long 120 mm smoothbore gun with thermal sleeve, smoke grenade launchers on the turret sides.

choice: a: the turret reads as a separate volume from above, which helps the split and the silhouette, and the gun is longer.

superseded.what: meshy_retexture of candidate a (multiview_image_urls = ref_a, ai_model latest) then Blender decimation 30.7k -> 12k triangles
superseded.why: meshy-6-lite geometry decimated to budget looked lumpy and melted up close. Replaced by smart topology.

steps: rotate 90° so the gun faces +Z, scale to 9.5 m, center, sit on y=0
paint by texture color (light olive) into untextured Paint; faces below 0.95 m stay Detail
cut P_turret and P_barrel by box, pivots on the turret ring and the gun trunnion, cap disk under the turret
clips: Fire (barrel recoil 0.45 m), TurretScan (keeps P_turret animated so the renderer doesn't merge it into the hull), Death (turret lifts)
